liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Paris, Bibliothèque nationale de France, MS 943
liebermann.notes: Pontifical for Sherborne, perhaps given there by Dunstan, with Old English pieces, in France from the late 11th century. Contains Sherborne documents and letters, the Consecratio regis, reginae with the Sacramentum coronationis (f. 67), Iudicium Dei I–III (ff. 89v–95v), the Excerptio de canonibus Egberti, and a 12th-century book list.

entries.text_de:
Paris, Bibliothèque nationale 943, um 975: Pontifical für Sherborne14, vielleicht15 dorthin von Dunstan geschenkt, mit Angelsächs. Stücken, seit Ende 11. Jhs. in Frankreich. F. 1b nachgetragen: Reihe der Bischöfe von Sherborne bis 1001/915; f. 2 Erzbischof [Sigric von Canterbury15] an Bischof Wulfsi 992—1001; f. 4—6 Bilder; f. 7 Johann XII.16 für Dunstan [96015].

F. 67 Consecratio regis, regine mit Sacr cor17.

F. 89b. 93b. 95b Iud Dei I. II. III, u. S. 401. 406. 408.

F. 147b Excerptio de canonibus Egberhti Eburac.18 Endet Pontifical.

F. 154b, Anfang 12. Jhs., Katalog der zum Theil Fränkischen librorum S. Marie, quos custodit Dodo, also aus Französischer Kirche.

F. 156 Sermo de dedicatione aecclesiae, Angelsächs.

F. 170 Briefe der Bischöfe W[ulfsige 992–1001]19 und Aethelric [1001—9]20 von Sherborne.
entries.text_en:
Paris, Bibliothèque nationale 943, c. 975: pontifical for Sherborne14, perhaps15 given there by Dunstan, with Anglo-Saxon pieces, in France since the end of the 11th century. F. 1b added: list of the bishops of Sherborne to 1001/915; f. 2 Archbishop [Sigric of Canterbury15] to Bishop Wulfsi, 992—1001; f. 4—6 pictures; f. 7 John XII16 for Dunstan [96015].

F. 67 Consecratio regis, regine with Sacr cor17.

F. 89b. 93b. 95b Iud Dei I. II. III, below, pp. 401. 406. 408.

F. 147b Excerptio de canonibus Egberhti Eburac.18 The pontifical ends.

F. 154b, beginning of the 12th century, catalogue of the partly Frankish librorum S. Marie, quos custodit Dodo, thus from a French church.

F. 156 Sermo de dedicatione aecclesiae, Anglo-Saxon.

F. 170 letters of the bishops W[ulfsige 992–1001]19 and Aethelric [1001—9]20 of Sherborne.
